majors.message: breakdown.fastRead: 2/4 (50%) of paragraphs open with abstract claims ("The X is…", "There is…", "Most people…", numbered-rule lists). Open with scenes, named characters, or direct address to the reader instead.

banned phrase "The mistake is treating" — WEBIS counter opener template ('The mistake is treating [body part] as [Y]…'). 5 of 10 WEBIS chapters used this construction. Narrow form to avoid false-firing on legitimate 'the mistake is treating it as urgent' body uses, while still catching the templating shell.
